fact_check_verdict: Publish as an attributed-allegation story. Claude-drafting claim is two professors' opinion, single source, no UA response found, no primary document reachable (alaska.edu 503). Never state a vote result.

claims.spoken: The University of Alaska regents are set to take up a systemwide A I plan at their November meeting.
requires: Say 'set to' or 'scheduled'. Never state a vote result, none is verified.

claims.spoken: Two U A A professors say Anthropic's Claude wrote its first draft.
claims.on_screen: TWO UAA PROFESSORS SAY · CLAUDE WROTE THE FIRST DRAFT
requires: Attribute to Hartley and Potter every time. Opinion column, single source, no UA confirmation.

claims.spoken: The university's own technology chief says he drafted the plan over the summer, at the regents' request.
claims.on_screen: UA IT CHIEF · DRAFTED OVER THE SUMMER
requires: Say 'technology chief', not CIO. ADN October 4th.

claims.spoken: The professors write that this wasn't disclosed until October ninth.
claims.on_screen: NOT DISCLOSED UNTIL OCT 9TH · THEY WRITE
requires: Attribute to the professors. 'Concealed' is their word, do not use it as fact.

claims.spoken: A U A A report says one hundred nineteen of one hundred fifty students cited for misconduct used A I.
requires: Say 'a U A A report' or 'per ADN'. The 1.1 percent is of all students, do not use.

claims.spoken: The same report says A I plagiarism rose seventy three percent last year.
requires: Attribute to the UAA report as reported by ADN.

claims.spoken: The plan would require all three campuses to have an A I plan for students, faculty and staff.
claims.on_screen: IF APPROVED · ALL 3 CAMPUSES NEED A PLAN
requires: Conditional on approval. September draft. Whether November keeps it is unverified.

claims.spoken: The draft came together over the summer without enough faculty and student feedback.
requires: Reporter text, not a Shier quote. No quote marks.

claims.spoken: A university official says A I could recommend, but a human decides.
claims.on_screen: "AI COULD RECOMMEND BUT A HUMAN DECIDES"
requires: Quote is Stephanie Erickson, UA special projects lead. Say 'a university official'.

claims.spoken: The professors say trusting A I to write the A I plan is the wrong approach.
requires: Verbatim: Trusting AI to generate UA's AI plan is the wrong approach. Attribute.

claims.spoken: We didn't find the university's response to the Claude claim.
requires: Say plainly we found no response. Do not imply confirm or deny.

claims.spoken: The university has no single A I policy across its campuses today.
The university's technology chief says it can't yet control and track every use of A I.
The professors say the regents should drop the plan.
A university official says the school needs to be deliberate about how it engages with A I.
requires: Erickson quote: We need to be deliberate with how we want to engage with AI instead of letting it just happen to us.

claims.spoken: The university's technology chief called the document very, very important.
